item.title: quant-investment-platform — mid-retrospective
item.description: A mid-project retrospective on a personal automated trading platform built with Rust + Python + React. With ETF rebalancing and single-stock signal trading both in place, a record of how the safety layers — halt, block, detect, simulate — got built before going live.

item.title: rust-server
item.description: A record of implementing the multithreaded HTTP server from Rust Book Chapter 20, experiencing how ownership and concurrency safety are enforced at the type level.
